description: This file contains unit tests for the WidgetWorker class in the org.apache.ofbiz.widget package. It verifies URL construction logic in the buildHyperlinkUri method, including handling of URL-encoded targets and spaces. The test setup includes mocking of CSRF token generation.

classes.name: WidgetWorkerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing URL building in WidgetWorker.

methods.name: setupMockups
methods.description: Sets up mock objects for the tests, specifically mocking CsrfUtil.

methods.name: buildsHyperlinkUriWithAlreadyUrlEncodedTarget
methods.description: Tests that buildHyperlinkUri correctly parses a URL-encoded target string.

methods.name: buildsHyperlinkUriWithSpaces
methods.description: Tests that buildHyperlinkUri correctly handles URLs with spaces, particularly scheme-specific parts.
